verdict.rationale: Column is a developer-facing banking API covering accounts, ACH, wires, cards and webhooks. It is not an AI agent or AI application that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it to use their tools is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows Column consuming external MCP tools; the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes concern serving its own documentation and spec, not acting as a client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
